TABLE.NAME: qtype_mcq_chill_options
TABLE.COMMENT: Options for QCM Chill questions: negative marking, all-or-nothing mode and shuffling.

FIELD.NAME: negativemarking
FIELD.COMMENT: Penalty for each wrong choice selected, as a fraction of the question mark, between -1 and 0.

FIELD.NAME: allornothing
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 if the mark is only awarded when all correct choices and no wrong choice are selected.

FIELD.NAME: shuffleanswers
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 if the choices are shuffled for each attempt.
